record.question: In order to prolong the duration of action of lignocaine, what drug should be added?
record.explanation: Answer A: Adrenaline. Adding epinephrine causes local vasoconstriction, slowing lidocaine absorption and prolonging its local anesthetic effect. Source/context note: Epinephrine-containing local anesthetic is not appropriate for every site/patient; assess contraindications. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557744/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
